text.en: Dog owners report significant behavioral turnarounds following board-and-train and in-home lessons, describing their dogs as calmer, more obedient, and responsive to commands. Clients frequently highlight marked progress in resolving leash pulling, reactivity, and general unruliness, enabling pets to accompany families in public settings.

title.en: Dedicated trainers coaching owners and dogs

text.en: Clients consistently praise lead trainer Tony and assistant trainers for their patience, clear guidance, and hands-on teaching approach. Reviewers emphasize that the trainers educate dog owners on consistency alongside training the pets, though one reviewer raised dissatisfaction regarding package fulfillment and owner communication.

Most clients describe communication throughout training programs as prompt, helpful, and reassuring, with trainers keeping families informed of progress during boot camps. However, feedback is mixed due to a customer dispute regarding unfulfilled class sessions and delayed responses regarding requested package adjustments.

q.en: What training formats are offered by Smart Start Puppies?

a.en: Clients report utilizing multi-week board-and-train programs as well as private in-home training lessons tailored to their household needs.

q.en: Do trainers assist with service dog or travel preparation?

a.en: Yes, reviewers mention training focused on obedience for airline flights and personalized assistance with mobility and service dog milestones.

q.en: Does the program include instruction for pet owners?

a.en: Yes, clients emphasize that trainers spend substantial time teaching owners how to maintain boundaries and reinforce learned behaviors at home.

q.en: Are young puppies accepted into the training programs?

a.en: Yes, pet parents report enrolling puppies as young as five months old to address jumping, leash pulling, and basic manners.
